test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Savage
solution: The correct answer is "**Civilised**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the **given word:** • **Savage**: (of a person or group) primitive and uncivilized.((किसी व्यक्ति या समूह का) आदिम और असभ्य) • **Example**: *She acted really **savage **__after she lost the title to her rival.* • Let's look at the **meaning **of the **given words.** • **Brutal**: direct and without attempting to disguise unpleasantness.(प्रत्यक्ष और अप्रियता को छिपाने का प्रयास किए बिना) • **Civilised**: bring (a place or people) to a stage of social and cultural development considered to be more advanced(अधिक उन्नत माने जाने वाले सामाजिक और सांस्कृतिक विकास के एक चरण में (एक स्थान या लोगों को) लाना). • **Adequate**: satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity.(गुणवत्ता या मात्रा में संतोषजनक या स्वीकार्य) • **impartial**: treating all rivals or disputants equally.(सभी प्रतिद्वंद्वियों या विवादों के साथ समान व्यवहार करना) • As per the meaning of the given words, "**civilised**" is the antonym of the word "**savage**" • **Example**:* Anirudh acted rather civilised at the party after being drunk, unlike his friends.* ​Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.** 45:T998, The correct answer is "**My elder brother works in a pharmaceutical company.**"
